tolerance.rule: Every repetition and pooled latency must meet the applicable ceiling; failures, timeouts, missing samples or unverified confinement fail qualification. No post-failure relaxation or discarded repetitions.

sampling.warmDefinition: fresh hook process, existing synthetic state
sampling.firstDefinition: new status database after untimed preflight, OS caches uncontrolled
sampling.comparison: Same source boundary, synthetic profile, runtime and Linux host class; inspect load and resource evidence. Material runtime/host changes need reviewed rebaselining with old evidence retained.

futureIntegratedConstraints.status: design constraints; integrated verification pending #3/#5/#6/#8 and consumers
futureIntegratedConstraints.overflow: Drop new observations at the producer; bounded loss indicator and later resync, no unbounded retry. Consumer coalescing must retain lifecycle ordering and loss evidence.
futureIntegratedConstraints.rationale: Queue covers a 50-event burst with bounded headroom; byte and service limits are explicit design constraints, not measured legacy queues or total service memory. Cadence caps rendering work independently of immediate hook return and never promises optical timing.

resourceScope: CPU sums reaped first/warm hooks and workers, excluding preflight/failure probes; RSS is largest child lifetime peak and may include preflight, not combined process memory.
reviewPolicy: Independent Standards and Specification review plus current-head CI and merged-main CI accept this version. Change any limit only through a documented reviewed PR.

componentReceipt.scope: released validators only; excludes full hook, future shared feed and devices; distinct resource/clock definitions

receiptChecksumPolicy: baselineSha256 and componentReceipt.sha256 hash decompressed original bytes; compressed-file hashes are in receipts/index.json.
